flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then store the exact stock or scarcity message shown on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") as stock_1.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed again so the page fully loads fresh, then store the first product's stock message as stock_2.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed once more, then store the first product's stock message as stock_3.
Read each value from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
